data.content_ref: inline:shared mechanism: The isolated artifact's discriminator (run-record perturbation-sensitivity) shares mechanism with the audit protocols of SRC_001–SRC_004 in that both operationalize a single counterexample-falsification logic — a falsifying intervention (injected false claim or mutated output) must flip the verdict. Refuted if the isolated artifact demands population-level negative controls (as SRC_003 argues) rather than a single perturbation, or if the same falsification logic can be satisfied by restatement without genuine world-dependent operation.
